themes.title: Elite Theory
themes.one_line: Who actually decides, and how that differs from the story on the news.
themes.guardrail: Analysis of power, not a hunt for bloodlines.
themes.why: The envelope is often an elite consensus posing as weather. Name the machinery.

resources.title: The Power Elite
resources.one_line: The mid-century map of interlocking civic, military, and economic command.

themes.title: Noblesse Oblige
themes.one_line: Privilege and high status carry a duty to act responsibly toward those with less of both.
themes.guardrail: An older welfare grammar. No racial component.
themes.why: The envelope insists the current welfare model is the only welfare model.

themes.title: Cyclical History
themes.one_line: Civilisations do not progress forever in a straight line. They thicken, peak, decay, and start again.
themes.guardrail: Analysis of history with no racial component.
themes.why: Challenges the official story of endless accumulating progress.
